Tarikh | Ep 1016 | 08 July 2025
In 1951, a young medical student named Ernesto Che Guevara set out on a life-changing 8-month motorcycle journey across South America with his friend Alberto Granado. This road trip became the foundation of Che's political awakening.
In this episode, we dive into The Motorcycle Diaries-
• Exploring the key moments that transformed Che from a doctor into a revolutionary icon.
